title: Strip load on an elastic half-space: stresses under the load (analytic)
description:
A uniform pressure p on a surface strip |x| < a pressing on a deep elastic block (plane strain), modelled as the half x > 0 (x_lo roller = the symmetry plane) of a 160 a x 160 a box with rollers on x_hi and y_lo (y_hi is the loaded free surface), graded: uniform dx = a / 8 over the 10 a x 10 a block near_field at the load (every probe and line), cells growing (ratio 1.15) to a beyond it. Outer-face loads cover whole faces, so the strip load is applied as body forces in the two top cell rows under the strip: f_y = -1.5 p / dx in the top row and +0.5 p / dx in the row below. Their sum is the load p a (per m of depth, half model) and their nodal forces (-3/4, -1/2, +1/4 of p dx at depths 0, dx, 2 dx) have zero first moment in depth, so the burial of the load is a second-order effect ((dx / a)^2); a single row at -p / dx would act dx / 2 below the surface (~2-3 % at z = a for a = 8 cells).
Analytic (Flamant strip, independent of E and nu): with theta_1,2 = atan((x +- a) / z), alpha = theta_1 - theta_2, z the depth below the surface: sigma_yy = -(p / pi) (alpha + sin(alpha) cos(theta_1 + theta_2)), sigma_xx = -(p / pi) (alpha - sin(alpha) cos(theta_1 + theta_2)); on the axis sigma_yy = -(2 p / pi) (atan(a / z) + a z / (a^2 + z^2)) (-0.818 p at z = a).
Derived values tab: F_y_bottom (bottom roller reaction = p a, exact equilibrium, 1e-6), syy_a / syy_2a (axis cell centres at z = a + dx/2 and 2 a + dx/2) and sxx_a against the formulas.
Line profile tab: syy_axis / sxx_axis down the axis from z = 3 dx to 8 a, syy_depth_a across at z = a + dx/2 from x = 0 to 4 a.
Expected agreement: the finite box (the rigid smooth base D below bends the layer: sigma_xx shifted by ~+P / (pi D) = 2 p a / (pi D) all down the axis; measured in a 40 a box: +0.016 p, i.e. -10 % of sxx_a = -0.16 p, while syy matched to 7e-4) and Q1 stresses ~(dx / a)^2; in the 160 a box the shift is ~0.004 p (~2.5 % of sxx_a). Tolerance 5 % (sxx_a 10 %: an offset of 1 % of p is already 6 % of its small value).

parameters.name: E_solid
parameters.description: Young's modulus in Pa (the stresses do not depend on it)

parameters.name: nu_solid
parameters.description: Poisson ratio (the stresses do not depend on it in plane strain)

parameters.name: a_half
parameters.description: half width of the loaded strip

parameters.name: W_box
parameters.description: box half width along x (graded: dx_mesh over near_field, then up to a_half)

parameters.name: D_box
parameters.description: box depth along y (graded like x); the loaded surface is y = D_box

parameters.name: R_near
parameters.description: side of the uniform dx_mesh block at the load (holds every probe and line)

parameters.name: x_p
parameters.description: probe x: the first cell column centre (next to the axis)

parameters.name: th1_1
parameters.description: angle to the far strip edge at probe 1

parameters.name: th2_1
parameters.description: angle to the near strip edge at probe 1

parameters.name: th1_2
parameters.description: angle to the far strip edge at probe 2

parameters.name: th2_2
parameters.description: angle to the near strip edge at probe 2

parameters.name: syy_1_ref
parameters.description: analytic sigma_yy at probe 1 in Pa (-0.80 p)

parameters.name: sxx_1_ref
parameters.description: analytic sigma_xx at probe 1 in Pa (-0.16 p)

parameters.name: syy_2_ref
parameters.description: analytic sigma_yy at probe 2 in Pa (-0.54 p)

analytic_curves.name: syy_axis
analytic_curves.expression: -p_load/pi*((atan((x + a_half)/(D_box - y)) - atan((x - a_half)/(D_box - y))) + sin(atan((x + a_half)/(D_box - y)) - atan((x - a_half)/(D_box - y)))*cos(atan((x + a_half)/(D_box - y)) + atan((x - a_half)/(D_box - y))))

analytic_curves.name: sxx_axis
analytic_curves.expression: -p_load/pi*((atan((x + a_half)/(D_box - y)) - atan((x - a_half)/(D_box - y))) - sin(atan((x + a_half)/(D_box - y)) - atan((x - a_half)/(D_box - y)))*cos(atan((x + a_half)/(D_box - y)) + atan((x - a_half)/(D_box - y))))

analytic_curves.name: syy_depth_a
analytic_curves.expression: -p_load/pi*((atan((x + a_half)/(D_box - y)) - atan((x - a_half)/(D_box - y))) + sin(atan((x + a_half)/(D_box - y)) - atan((x - a_half)/(D_box - y)))*cos(atan((x + a_half)/(D_box - y)) + atan((x - a_half)/(D_box - y))))
